questions.title: Pendulum hanging from a V-shaped string
questions.summary: The bob swings at right angles to the rule, pivoting about the line of the rule, so its effective length grows as the V narrows. Plot T² against cos(θ/2): gradient 4π²l/g and intercept c.

xlsx.desc: θ and 20-oscillation timings for six angles. Plot T² against cos(θ/2).

questions.title: Resistance wire with two resistors
questions.summary: A length L of wire in parallel with one resistor R, in series with a second R across which V is read. (E − V)/L = PV − Q gives Q/P = E/2 and P = 2k/R.

xlsx.desc: Six (L, V) readings; plot (E − V)/L against V and find Q/P.

questions.title: Sand flowing through a funnel
questions.summary: Find the masses of sand from depth measurements, time the sand through a funnel, and test whether the flow rate depends on the mass in the funnel. Plan a power-law study of hopper flow (grain size and stem diameter) and analyse a height–time dataset with a half-life.

xlsx.desc: A practice version of datasetQ3f: h every 2 s. Read successive half-lives and plot ln h against t.
